scope: Offline production C# simulation compiled in memory with PowerShell Add-Type. No Unity/native performance or visual acceptance claim.
setup: Generate Island; paint Grass circle (64, 64, radius 20) and Forest circle (78, 64, radius 7).
Disable Warfare; spawn 1000 Humans at (64, 64); ordinary fixed ticks. Forced population is explicit test assistance.
Apply Fire at (67, 65), radius 3, after 1200 completed ticks; apply Rain at the same center, radius 8, after 1280 completed ticks.
Validate every 100 iterations; count activity for each living unit after every tick. No skipped ticks.
limitations: Per-tick timing measured with Stopwatch under .NET; not Unity Mono/IL2CPP.
Allocation includes audit arrays and state validations, not just simulation.
This is 500 simulated seconds offline, not 30 minutes of Player stability.
